subject.title: CI unused-exports dead-code lane is silently broken; no symbol-level dead-code enforcement

question: Should this protected issue now be promoted for the focused Knip symbol-ratchet implementation?
rationale: The defect and repair boundary are high-confidence, but the `maintainer` label explicitly requires owner approval before ClawSweeper repair intake.

options.title: Promote focused fix
options.body: Implement and enforce the pinned-Knip symbol ratchet while removing both obsolete scanners and their advisory artifact path.

options.title: Defer enforcement
options.body: Keep the issue open and continue manual dead-export cleanup without adding the CI ratchet yet.

recommendation.title: Promote focused fix
recommendation.body: Implement and enforce the pinned-Knip symbol ratchet while removing both obsolete scanners and their advisory artifact path.

likelyOwner.reason: They sponsored this issue and introduced the existing strict Knip guard pattern that the proposed repair extends.
